A request-keyed cache must be a BoundedCache (src/server/lib/boundedCache.ts) and is NOT listed here. Each entry below is a raw Map/Set with the reason it cannot grow with traffic. A new raw one fails tests/boundedCaches.test.ts until it becomes a BoundedCache or is listed with a real reason (audit 2026-10-11).
